# Official TASSEL/rTASSEL maize tutorial data

These five files are distributed by the Maize Genetics rTASSEL project, not generated by LDblockR.

Repository: https://github.com/maize-genetics/rTASSEL
Pinned commit: e8cbfcce47422319b5bfe8376cf5550ebd3b365e
Original directory: inst/extdata/
Tutorial: https://rtassel.maizegenetics.net/articles/rTASSEL.html
Retrieved and verified: 2026-09-02

Every file is byte-identical to the copy supplied for this project. Exact URLs, SHA-256 checksums and sizes are in PROVENANCE.json. The files are unchanged; the original repository license is retained in LICENSE.rTASSEL.txt. This distribution retains upstream attribution and makes no claim to ownership of the data.

The genotype file contains 281 samples, 3,093 markers and AGPv1 coordinates. The HapMap allele metadata conflict with some observed calls at 48 markers; the default LDblockR policy excludes those markers and records each decision. The original data remain intact.

Cite the original software resources:
- Bradbury et al. (2007), TASSEL. https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btm308
- Monier et al. (2022), rTASSEL. https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.04530
